entities.summary: Kasey Juwan Shepherd is an American professional basketball player who plays as a guard for KK Bosna BH Telecom of the Bosnian League and the ABA League. He has competed for multiple clubs across Europe since beginning his professional career in 2017, including in Montenegro, Hungary, Georgia, Ukraine, Turkey, Romania, Israel and Russia.
